title: toorow Datastream safe KPI projection plan (Story 12.4)
description: Derived, deterministic artifact compiled from ONE immutable 12.3 mapping version. Encodes the full-grain relation shape (all dimensions preserved at the declared joint grain), the safe canonical projection (additive measures + exactly one governed dimension projection into fact_daily_kpi), the cardinality/scan estimate, and the closed set of compile-time rejection issues. Never a mart writer.

executable.description: True iff issues is empty. A projection with ANY issue fails closed and blocks publication (12.5 owns publication).

grain.description: The declared joint grain (ordered field_ids). Every selected dimension is preserved in the full-grain relation.

additive_measures.description: Measures accepted into fact_daily_kpi. A measure is accepted ONLY iff aggregation='sum' AND non_additive=false via app.mdm_canonical_fields.

governed_dimension_projection.description: The SINGLE governed dimension projected into the canonical breakdown_dimension/breakdown_value slot, or null when no dimension is projected. Never more than one.

issues.description: Closed set of deterministic compile-time rejection issues. Non-empty => not executable => blocks publication.

provenance.description: Provenance columns carried on every full-grain row and queryable alongside the grain.

full_grain_relation.description: One row per the declared joint grain. Every selected dimension is its own typed column (never collapsed into a breakdown_dimension/breakdown_value pair). Distinct artifact from fact_daily_kpi.

grain_columns.description: Ordered typed grain columns (one per selected dimension).

grain_key.description: Deterministic '|'-joined ordered grain values. AI-05 uniqueness key: no two rows share a grain_key.

source_fields.description: Every selected source measure/field kept as its own typed column (not aggregated away).

metric.description: Canonical metric name landing in fact_daily_kpi.metric.

governed_dimension_projection.description: Exactly one governed source dimension mapped to the canonical breakdown slot. It must sort so MIN(breakdown_dimension) never selects it (a parallel series, not a new canonical slot).

breakdown_dimension.description: Value landing in fact_daily_kpi.breakdown_dimension for this projected series.

estimate.description: Metadata-based cardinality/scan estimate (no live BigQuery dry-run in 12.4). Compared against the project-scoped governed threshold.

expensive_fields.description: Concrete field_ids driving the estimate over the limit (named, never silently dropped).

threshold_source.description: project_preference when app.project_preferences supplied the value; documented_default otherwise (no platform-wide hardcode leaks silently).

approved.description: True when the operator supplied the explicit governed approval flag/reason for an over-limit projection.
